notes:
Sourced directly from Powersoft's own documentation (manufacturer, high authority): the 2-page Quattrocanali DSP+D Series datasheet (primary sourceUrl), the Quattrocanali 4804 DSP+Dante Architect's & Engineer's Specification (https://www.powersoft.com/wp-content/uploads/AE_Specs/PS_Quattrocanali4804_DSPD_AE.pdf), and the Duecanali/Quattrocanali Series User Guide (https://www.powersoft.com/wp-content/uploads/user_guide/PS_duecanaliquattrocanali_UG.pdf). Cross-checked against B&H/Sweetwater listings via search snippets.

Caveats:
- The 4 analog inputs and 4 speaker outputs each share a single multi-pole Phoenix pluggable terminal block (12-pole for inputs, per the datasheet's "Phoenix MC 1,5/12-ST-3,81"; a larger multi-pole "Phoenix PC 5/8-STF1-7,62" for outputs) rather than 4 separate connector bodies. They are listed here per-channel (Input 1-4 / Output 1-4) to match the datasheet's own channel-count breakdown and because each is an independently routable signal path, but physically they are pins on one or two terminal blocks, not 4 discrete jacks.
- Powersoft's product page states the unit supports a "remotely switchable double input (main and aux) per channel" for input redundancy/backup, and the box ships with a second 12-pole input plug — implying a secondary AUX analog input path per channel. This was not confirmed to be a physically distinct rear-panel connector (vs. an alternate wiring position on the same block) so it was not enumerated as separate ports.
- The Alarm (GPO) and Remote On/Off (GPI) connectors are both documented as Phoenix pluggable terminal blocks in Powersoft's A&E spec, but the exact pin/pole count and whether they are one physical block or two was not confirmed for this specific 4-channel model (a 6-pin part is documented for the 2-channel Duecanali sibling in the same shared manual).
- AC inlet is IEC C20 (mates with an IEC C19 cord) — mapped to the "iec-c19" (high-current IEC) connector id per instructions, since it is not the common C13/C14 (10 A) type.
- Dante port grade (Gigabit) comes from the A&E spec text ("Connectors shall be gigabit RJ45 utilizing CAT6 cable"); the separate control Ethernet port's 100 Mbit/s grade comes from the datasheet's general "Networking" table — these are two distinct RJ45 jacks on the rear panel (visible together in the datasheet's rear-panel photo, both under an "ALARM"-labeled zone alongside the GPIO terminals).
- Rack size: 483 x 44.5 x 358 mm (1U), weight 6.8 kg (15 lb).

ports.name: Input 1
ports.note: Balanced analog audio input, channel 1 of 4. Physically part of a shared 12-pole Phoenix MC 1,5/12-ST-3,81 pluggable terminal block covering all 4 analog inputs (3 pins/channel).

ports.name: Input 2
ports.note: Balanced analog audio input, channel 2 of 4 (shared 12-pole Phoenix terminal block, see Input 1).

ports.name: Input 3
ports.note: Balanced analog audio input, channel 3 of 4 (shared 12-pole Phoenix terminal block, see Input 1).

ports.name: Input 4
ports.note: Balanced analog audio input, channel 4 of 4 (shared 12-pole Phoenix terminal block, see Input 1).

ports.name: Output 1
ports.note: Speaker/Hi-Z output, channel 1 of 4 (bridgeable per channel pair). Phoenix PC 5/8-STF1-7,62 pluggable terminal block.

ports.name: Dante
ports.note: Dante/AES67 digital audio networking, 4 channel capacity. Powersoft's Architect & Engineer spec states the Dante connector is Gigabit RJ45 over CAT6.

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: Control/monitoring port for ArmoníaPlus software, separate from the Dante port. Auto-sensing Fast Ethernet (IEEE 802.3u, 100 Mbit/s) per datasheet.

ports.name: Alarm
ports.note: GPO fault/alarm relay contacts (NO+NC pair per channel) on a Phoenix pluggable terminal block, labeled ALARM on the rear panel. A 6-pin Phoenix MC 1,5/6-ST-3,81 part is documented for the 2-channel Duecanali sibling in the shared user guide; exact pole count for this 4-channel model's block was not separately confirmed.

ports.name: Remote On/Off
ports.note: GPI-style differential-voltage remote power on/off terminals on a Phoenix pluggable terminal block, per Powersoft's Architect & Engineer spec ("Phoenix GPI connector"). May share the same rear-panel block area as the Alarm/GPO connector; not independently confirmed as a physically separate connector body.

ports.name: AC Mains
ports.note: IEC C20 inlet (device-side male pins, mates with IEC C19 cord), 20 A max, universal 100-240 VAC PFC switch-mode supply. Region-specific power cord provided.
